difficulty_reason: The authors reconstruct a group delooping from generating loops/relations and alternatively recover the full torsor loop group from restricted generator actions. The proofs use higher-inductive inverse maps, quotient descent and nontrivial transport identities. Both constructions have the same delooping purpose and are grouped into one count.
